synth.notes:
Blocks move together on a 4-grid (A1 y-4, A2 y+4, A3 apart, A4 together). Each block moves only if its target cell is free: bounds [2,58], invisible maze cells, marker cells, the other block.
Missed mechanic at step 124: block_left 18->22 at y18 is blocked by an invisible maze cell (22,18). Maze = {(14,38),(6,18),(38,14),(22,18)}. block_right is not confined to its half. Without this cell, only step 124 fails.
Click a marker to arm: blocks become players and the marker becomes active. While armed, A1-A4 steer the active marker. Click another marker to switch, click a player to disarm; other clicks do nothing.
Hidden state: action counter a, gated on continuity; bar w=3(a+1)//7. Fallback a=(7w+2)//3, or 0 if there is no bar. The left player position is also kept.
Names are type_color_rank by (y,x). Block mode ranks others from 2, armed mode ranks all from 0. Unconfirmed: other unseen maze cells, and behaviour at level completion.
